 Syntax: 	listen

    [proxy_protocol]

    port
    [default_server]
    [ssl]
    [http2 | quic]

    [fastopen=number]

    unix:path
    [default_server]
    [ssl]
    [http2 | quic]
    [proxy_protocol]
    [backlog=number]

    [sndbuf=size]
    [accept_filter=filter]
    [deferred]
    [bind]
